title: README gate-mapping table omits 2 of the workflow's 11 named steps (Install Odin, Linux GUI link deps) — not 1:1
evidence:
README.md:68-80: "| GH CI step | Local stage |
| Purity + grep gates (ODN-1) | `tools/lint.sh` |
| Core unit tests (determinism + topology) | `odin test core` |
| Game builds (app.bin compiles + links) | `odin build app -out:app.bin` |
| Golden harness (T1 + T2 + replay gate) | `tools/harness.sh run` |
| W1 drift-rejection negative test | `tools/harness.sh drift-check` |
| Assist preview cross-check (R2a preview == sim) | `tools/harness.sh preview-check` |
| PP_DEBUG overlay builds (compile gate) | `odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true` + `odin build harness -define:PP_DEBUG=true` |
| Stats stream replay-identity | `tools/harness.sh stats-check pause` + `qos_contention` |
| Upload diff bundles on failure | `goldens/_reports/` (bind-mounted out of the container) |" — 9 rows. ci.yml named steps: "- name: Install Odin (pinned release artifact)" (line 26), "- name: Linux GUI link deps" (line 36), "- name: Purity + grep gates (ODN-1)" ... "- name: Upload diff bundles on failure" = 11 total. spec-local-ci-suite.md:65: "README.md — 'Local CI suite' section: usage, gate-mapping table (all 11 workflow steps), artifact-isolation note, known traps (odin pin warning, arch note, docker down, goldens bit-identical, fast-is-warm-only, timeouts, windows-cross semantics)."
detail: Lens guard requires the mapping table to match workflow steps 1:1; the implementer's own spec claims 'all 11 workflow steps' but the table has 9 rows. The two setup steps appear only in prose (README.md:63).
recommended_fix: Add 'Install Odin (pinned release artifact)' and 'Linux GUI link deps' rows mapping to Dockerfile.ci stages (or amend the spec artifact's 'all 11' claim) so the table is 1:1.

title: run_container's --windows-cross passthrough is unreachable; 'use --in-container for the container's' hint runs the probe on the host
evidence:
tools/ci-local.sh:182: "  [ "$WIN_CROSS" -eq 1 ] && extra+=(--windows-cross)" — inside run_container, but dispatch at 219-223 runs first: "# --windows-cross probes the LOCAL toolchain by default (briefing AC: "given
# the mac toolchain"); only --in-container probes the container's toolchain.
if [ "$WIN_CROSS" -eq 1 ]; then
  run_windows_cross
  exit $?
fi" — so run_container is only reached with WIN_CROSS=0 and the line is dead. usage text 32-33: "tools/ci-local.sh --windows-cross # EXPERIMENTAL: compile-only windows cross-build
                                    # (probes the LOCAL toolchain; use --in-container for the container's)". Success branch 114-117: "if [ "$IN_CONTAINER" -eq 1 ]; then
      echo "   ✅ windows_amd64 cross-build succeeded → app-win.exe (in-container; the --rm container discards it)"" — reachable on a host run of `--in-container --windows-cross`.
detail: The container-leg windows probe is not reachable through the one entrypoint (dispatch exits before run_container); following the usage hint runs a HOST probe that, in the success branch, prints an in-container message that is false.
recommended_fix: Either route --windows-cross through run_container (the dead passthrough suggests that intent) or drop the passthrough and document the container-leg probe as a manual `docker run ... --in-container --windows-cross`.
